answer: Duplicate identities collide on the same relic hash, so a sybil farm must acquire and stake fresh marbles per fake identity while burning real value each epoch, making mass forgery economically irrational. Agents stake a unique marble token minted at registration, and each epoch they must prove control of a relic keypair tied to a verified off-chain identity anchored on a knoll of trusted registrars. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
